title: Zesty Bitter French Ginger Crepes
description: A French-inspired brunch dish featuring ginger paste and dashi extract in a sugar-free crepe, served in a cataplana vessel, with a bitter and aerated twist.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together buckwheat flour, eggs, ginger paste, dashi extract, and salt until smooth.
Gradually add unsweetened almond milk to the bowl and whisk until the batter is well combined and free of lumps.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat and brush with melted butter.
Pour about 1/4 cup of the batter into the pan and tilt to evenly coat the bottom.
Cook the crepe for about 2 minutes, until the bottom is light brown, then loosen with a spatula and flip.
Cook the other side for another minute, until light brown, then repeat with the remaining batter.
Serve the crepes in a cataplana vessel, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
To enhance the bitter flavor, serve with a side of bitter greens or citrus wedges.
